hypothesis.mechanism: Formal factor-base prime multisets provide syntax. If EC evaluation is injective on the order ideal generated by selected balanced degree-four formal multisets, multiset union induces an associative EC-compatible partial operation with unique prime-multiset factorization.
assumptions: MODEL-BOUND: the cited theorem concerns a hard distribution over compatible labelings, not the conventional coordinates of a named curve.
UNTESTED: useful four-witness closures survive EC semantic collisions at nontrivial coverage.
HEURISTIC: coordinate-only greedy pruning at 10-12 bits may provide a useful lower bound but cannot prove a class negative.
TOY-EVIDENCE: all scheduled groups are far below cryptographic size.
